sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 14 August 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000066-P1 was put before Northstar Urgent Care 066 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 3.25 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Tdap minimum take of 730 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer came back with a counter.
